items.title: Sections of an etale sheaf over the spectrum of a henselian pair agree with sections over the closed fibre
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a henselian pair (A, I) with X = Spec(A) and Z = Spec(A/I), the sections of any sheaf F on X_etale over X agree with the sections of its restriction over Z (statement lines 15179-15184). The proof (proof lines 15186-15199) reduces to the Zariski statement using the connectedness of the trace of the closure of a point on the closed fibre, verifies it after every finite base change, and applies Gabber's comparison lemma for the h-topology. H2: a reduction through a topological statement and an induction over finite morphisms, written out in full.
